model.version: same inherited task snapshot for both arms; provider build identifier unavailable
model.parity_requirement: Arm B and Arm C workers must use the same inherited parent model without an override.

settings.seed: not exposed; paired seed claims are forbidden

fairness_repair.repair_scope: Restore a missing Luke draft, Matthew audit, one Luke revision, or deterministic format check only; then rerun all three Arm B replicates. Do not use evaluator preferences or add Kyle artifacts.

comparison.aggregate: median route-neutral score across three replicates

provenance_policy.current_grade_limit: A passing run may be retained as diagnostic fixture evidence but may not create command wrappers or authorize registration.
